dimensions.assessment: Affects applicants and rural communities seeking grants under the Community Connect Grant Program.
dimensions.evidence: projects under the Community Connect Grant Program

dimensions.assessment: Raises technical broadband speed criteria from 10-Mbps to 25-Mbps download and 1-Mbps to 3-Mbps upload.
dimensions.evidence: striking 10-Mbps and inserting 25-Mbps... striking 1-Mbps and inserting 3-Mbps

dimensions.assessment: Modifies project standards within an existing grant program, potentially impacting project costs without altering appropriated totals.
dimensions.evidence: To increase the minimum broadband service capacity for projects under the Community Connect Grant Program

dimensions.assessment: Makes targeted amendments to the Rural Electrification Act of 1936.
dimensions.evidence: Section 604(a)(2) of the Rural Electrification Act of 1936 (7 U.S.C. 950bb-3(a)(2)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory criteria taking effect 6 months after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this Act shall take effect 6 months after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Number of future grant projects that will meet or fail the new speed thresholds.
importance_detail.rationale: Increases the minimum broadband service capacity requirements for projects funded under the Community Connect Grant Program.
